posts.author: NinjaPikachu
posts.body: Hi everyone, I'm looking for an RPG Maker MZ plugin that allows me to change the MP bar's name and color per actor. I know I can change the general name in the Database, but I want one character to have a 'Mana' bar and another to have a 'Stamina' bar. I found a plugin like this for MV, but I specifically need one for MZ. Can anyone help?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: VisuStella Skill and States Core you can replace your actor gauges with different gauges using notetags.

I was thinking earlier, and instead of fiddling with the plugin parameters for your cost color (i think that’s the color you wanna change!)it may be easier to use the <Custom Cost Text> note tag.
So say you want an ability to cost 14 Stamina, put 14 in the MP cost in the editor, and within the notetags I think you’d put
<Custom Cost Text>
\C[x]14
</Custom Cost Text>
where x is the number of the color in your window system img (but i think you may can use hex codes too?)
